verdict.rationale: kongctl supports declarative configuration for managing AI Gateway resources as code (docs-41, probe-4). That implies the config could be versioned and reviewed in external source control and re-applied to restore a prior state, but the evidence never documents built-in versioning, review, or rollback. Missing for 10: native config version history, review/approval workflow, documented rollback mechanism, any hands-on or independent corroboration of a GitOps-style rollback flow.
